from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import json,hashlib,re,pandas as pd
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_source_qualification_v1'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save(name,obj):(out/name).write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
protocol=json.loads((out/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'));freeze=json.loads((out/'freeze.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert not (out/'result.json').exists() and sha(out/'protocol.json')==freeze['protocol_sha256']
for rel,h in freeze['parent_input_hashes'].items():assert sha(root/rel)==h
receipts=json.loads((out/'source_receipts.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['receipts']
support=json.loads((out/'support_source_receipt.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert len(receipts)==2 and all(x['status']=='SAVED_ORIGINAL' for x in receipts) and support['status']=='SAVED_ORIGINAL'
facts={};excerpts=[]
def number(s):return float(s.replace(',',''))
def amount(text,pattern):
 m=re.search(pattern,text);assert m,(pattern,text)
 return number(m.group(1))*(1000 if len(m.groups())>=2 and m.group(2)=='trillion' else 1)
for rec in receipts:
 p=root/rec['path'];assert sha(p)==rec['sha256']
 soup=BeautifulSoup(p.read_bytes(),'html.parser');text=' '.join(soup.get_text(' ',strip=True).split())
 assert 'Treasury Announces Marketable Borrowing Estimates' in soup.title.get_text(' ',strip=True)
 date='May 1, 2023' if rec['date']=='20230501' else 'July 31, 2023';assert date in text[:text.index('WASHINGTON')]
 bullets=[' '.join(x.get_text(' ',strip=True).split()) for x in soup.find_all('li')]
 q3=[x for x in bullets if x.startswith('During the July') and 'September 2023 quarter' in x];assert len(q3)==1;q3=q3[0]
 borrowing=amount(q3,r'expects to borrow \$([\d,.]+)\s+(billion|trillion)')
 endcash=amount(q3,r'end-of-September cash balance of \$([\d,.]+) billion')
 item={'publication_date':date,'source_url':rec['url'],'source_sha256':rec['sha256'],'quarter':'2023Q3',
  'q3_privately_held_net_marketable_borrowing_billion_usd':borrowing,'q3_end_cash_target_billion_usd':endcash}
 if rec['date']=='20230501':
  q2=[x for x in bullets if x.startswith('During the April') and 'June 2023 quarter' in x];assert len(q2)==1
  item['q3_start_cash_assumption_billion_usd']=amount(q2[0],r'end-of-June cash balance of \$([\d,.]+) billion')
  assert 'assume enactment of a debt limit suspension or increase' in text
  item['cash_targets_conditional_on_debt_limit_change']=True
 else:
  paragraphs=[' '.join(x.get_text(' ',strip=True).split()) for x in soup.find_all('p')]
  q2=[x for x in paragraphs if x.startswith('During the April') and 'Treasury borrowed' in x];assert len(q2)==1
  item['q3_start_actual_cash_billion_usd']=amount(q2[0],r'cash balance of \$([\d,.]+) billion')
  item['reported_borrowing_revision_billion_usd']=amount(q3,r'borrowing estimate is \$([\d,.]+) billion higher')
  item['reported_lower_start_cash_contribution_billion_usd']=amount(q3,r'lower beginning-of-quarter\s+cash balance \(\$([\d,.]+) billion\)')
  item['reported_higher_end_cash_contribution_billion_usd']=amount(q3,r'higher end-of-quarter cash balance \(\$([\d,.]+) billion\)')
  item['reported_lower_receipts_higher_outlays_contribution_billion_usd']=amount(q3,r'lower receipts and higher outlays \(\$([\d,.]+) billion\)')
  assert '$22 billion of SOMA Treasury holdings dated September 30, 2023' in text and 'will settle in October' in text
 assert 'excludes rollovers' in text and 'includes financing required due to SOMA redemptions' in text
 facts[rec['date']]=item;excerpts.append({'date':rec['date'],'q3_bullet':q3,'source_url':rec['url']})
assert sha(root/support['path'])==support['sha256']
pdf=json.loads((out/'PDF全部页文字与表格.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'));assert len(pdf['texts'])==1
lines=pdf['texts'][0]['text'].splitlines()
idx=next(i for i,line in enumerate(lines) if line.startswith('Jul - Sep May 1, 2023 '))
prefixes=['Jul - Sep May 1, 2023 ','2023 July 31, 2023 ','Forecast Revisions ']
columns=['financing_need','marketable_borrowing','all_other_sources','financing_total','change_in_cash_balance','end_cash_balance','soma_redemptions_memo']
rows=[]
def integer(s):
 s=s.replace(',','')
 return -int(s[1:-1]) if s.startswith('(') else int(s)
for n,prefix in enumerate(prefixes):
 line=lines[idx+n];assert line.startswith(prefix)
 tokens=re.findall(r'\(?-?\d[\d,]*\)?',line[len(prefix):]);assert len(tokens)==7
 rows.append({'row':['20230501_forecast','20230731_forecast','published_forecast_revisions'][n],
  **dict(zip(columns,[integer(s) for s in tokens])),'source_url':support['url'],'source_pdf_page':1})
old,new,reported=rows
assert old['marketable_borrowing']==facts['20230501']['q3_privately_held_net_marketable_borrowing_billion_usd']
assert new['marketable_borrowing']==facts['20230731']['q3_privately_held_net_marketable_borrowing_billion_usd']
assert old['end_cash_balance']==facts['20230501']['q3_end_cash_target_billion_usd']
assert new['end_cash_balance']==facts['20230731']['q3_end_cash_target_billion_usd']
startold=facts['20230501']['q3_start_cash_assumption_billion_usd'];startnew=facts['20230731']['q3_start_actual_cash_billion_usd']
assert old['end_cash_balance']-old['change_in_cash_balance']==startold
assert new['end_cash_balance']-new['change_in_cash_balance']==startnew
delta={k:new[k]-old[k] for k in columns}
head=delta['marketable_borrowing'];start_contribution=startold-startnew;end_contribution=delta['end_cash_balance']
cash_adjusted=head-start_contribution-end_contribution
budget=delta['financing_need'];other=delta['all_other_sources']
display_gap=head-(start_contribution+end_contribution+budget-other)
assert head==facts['20230731']['reported_borrowing_revision_billion_usd']
assert budget==reported['financing_need']==facts['20230731']['reported_lower_receipts_higher_outlays_contribution_billion_usd']
assert start_contribution==facts['20230731']['reported_lower_start_cash_contribution_billion_usd']
assert end_contribution==facts['20230731']['reported_higher_end_cash_contribution_billion_usd']
assert delta['soma_redemptions_memo']==reported['soma_redemptions_memo']==0
components=[
 {'cause':'期初现金假设落差','borrowing_revision_contribution_billion_usd':start_contribution},
 {'cause':'期末现金目标提高','borrowing_revision_contribution_billion_usd':end_contribution},
 {'cause':'融资需要增加（原文较低收入/较高支出）','borrowing_revision_contribution_billion_usd':budget},
 {'cause':'其他融资来源变化抵消','borrowing_revision_contribution_billion_usd':-other},
 {'cause':'原表显示精度残差，未取得未取整值','borrowing_revision_contribution_billion_usd':display_gap}]
assert sum(x['borrowing_revision_contribution_billion_usd'] for x in components)==head
checks={'old_private_plus_other_minus_total':old['marketable_borrowing']+old['all_other_sources']-old['financing_total'],
 'new_private_plus_other_minus_total':new['marketable_borrowing']+new['all_other_sources']-new['financing_total'],
 'revision_private_plus_other_minus_total':delta['marketable_borrowing']+delta['all_other_sources']-delta['financing_total'],
 'old_total_minus_need_minus_cash_change':old['financing_total']-old['financing_need']-old['change_in_cash_balance'],
 'new_total_minus_need_minus_cash_change':new['financing_total']-new['financing_need']-new['change_in_cash_balance']}
pd.DataFrame(facts.values()).to_csv(out/'两份公告同Q3字段.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
pd.DataFrame(rows).to_csv(out/'原PDF同Q3两预估及修订行.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
pd.DataFrame(components).to_csv(out/'借款修订完整构成含显示残差.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
save('原文定位摘录.json',excerpts)
result={'study_id':protocol['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E10','completed_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),
 'status':'COMPLETED_MATCHED_QUARTER_BORROWING_REVISION_CAUSES_ACCEPTED_FACT_ONLY',
 'classification':'PROGRESS_UPSTREAM_EXPECTED_FINANCING_REVISION_COMPONENTS',
 'fixed_quarter':'2023Q3','source_objects':3,'release_dates':['2023-05-01','2023-07-31'],'source_unit':'billion_USD',
 'prior_borrowing':old['marketable_borrowing'],'revised_borrowing':new['marketable_borrowing'],'borrowing_revision':head,
 'prior_start_cash_assumption':startold,'revised_start_actual_cash':startnew,'start_cash_contribution':start_contribution,
 'prior_end_cash_target':old['end_cash_balance'],'revised_end_cash_target':new['end_cash_balance'],'end_cash_contribution':end_contribution,
 'total_cash_contribution':start_contribution+end_contribution,'cash_contribution_share_of_headline':(start_contribution+end_contribution)/head,
 'cash_adjusted_borrowing_revision':cash_adjusted,'source_financing_need_revision':budget,'all_other_sources_revision':other,
 'other_sources_contribution':-other,'display_precision_residual':display_gap,'displayed_precision_checks':checks,
 'exact_unrounded_reconciliation_verified':False,'soma_revision_same_quarter':0,'soma_redemptions_in_private_borrowing':True,
 'quarter_boundary_soma_22_billion_settles_in_october_not_q3_borrowing':True,
 'same_quarter_source_gate_passed':True,'source_first_vintage_verified':False,'actual_historical_receipt_verified':False,
 'actual_market_consensus_verified':False,'full_historical_series_admitted':False,'causal_equity_effect_identified':False,
 'independent_validation':False,'equity_labels_loaded':False,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'account_net_sharpe':None,
 'new_repository_code_edits':0,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'orders_authorized':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','goal_achieved':False}
save('result.json',result)
save('source_gate.json',{'status':'PASSED_FIXED_TWO_RELEASE_SAME_QUARTER_SOURCE_FACT_ONLY','two_body_dates_and_fields_matched':True,
 'support_pdf_all_relevant_page_visually_inspected':True,'pdf_pages':1,'source_objects':3,
 'source_hashes':{x['path']:x['sha256'] for x in [*receipts,support]},
 'historical_first_vintage_verified':False,'exact_unrounded_reconciliation_verified':False,'display_precision_residual':display_gap,
 'no_zero_fill_or_equity_labels':True,'fields_or_quarter_changed':False})
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
